column1: # Expected census of the frozen extractor corpus -- the extractor pin.
# This is what scripts/citation_audit.py must say about guide.tex, notes.md,
# tracked.txt and untracked.txt, which never change when a live document is
# edited. A diff here is therefore a change in the *extractor* (a resolution rule
# relaxed, a variant tokenised differently, a class re-attributed) and has to be
# justified as one.
# Deliberately hand-maintained: there is no flag that regenerates it, because a
# one-command refresh is how an extractor pin turns into a rubber stamp. Free-text
# comment lines are not compared; #tracked, #census and the rows are.
# What each corpus line is here to catch, and the relaxation it detects:
#   Corpus/Resolved.lean (macro, path)   the ordinary resolved citation
#   Corpus/Under\_Score.lean             the LaTeX escape, unescaped before lookup
#   Corpus/Pair/\{A, Gone\}.lean         brace shorthand: one token, two citations
#   Corpus/Gone.lean (tex and md)        MISSING, and it must stay MISSING even
#                                        though untracked.txt puts a copy of that
#                                        file on disk -- swap git ls-files for a
#                                        filesystem walk and this row moves
#   Corpus/Pair/Gone.lean                MISSING through a brace alternative
#   Alone.lean                           BASENAME_ONLY: a name is not a path
#   Twin.lean                            AMBIGUOUS: two tracked files match
#   ../Corpus/Resolved.lean              MALFORMED: the glued run is charged whole
#   Corpus/Resolved.lean.bak             MALFORMED: the same, on the right
#   Corpus/Resolved~1.lean               MALFORMED because '~' is in no component
#                                        name here -- drop normalise's TOKEN_CHARS
#                                        test and it becomes MISSING
#   Score.lean                           MISSING: 'Under_Score.lean' does not end at
#                                        a component boundary here. Loosen the
#                                        suffix table to a string endswith and this
#                                        becomes BASENAME_ONLY -- the corpus's own
#                                        charge against the relaxation this suite's
#                                        docstring names first
#   Corpus/Wrapped/ then Bridge.lean     a wrapped source line, rejoined
#   +-- Corpus/ then indented Alone.lean a tree heading, never joined
#   indented Corpus/ then Alone.lean     the same rule from the other side: the
#                                        *prefix* is the indented line, so it is a
#                                        tree entry too. rstrip -> strip joins it
#                                        and turns this BASENAME_ONLY into RESOLVED
#   *.lean and .lean                     acknowledged non-citations
#   Corpus/Moved.lean >> Moved.lean      SELFREF, in both syntaxes
# One relaxation is deliberately absent: dropping NON_CITATION's left-delimiter
# test can only *add* acknowledgements, so it cannot move a census that already
# accounts for every occurrence -- it surfaces as a coverage failure instead, and
# is pinned by test_non_citation_list_is_an_enumeration_not_a_wildcard.
